name: helpme-dsh
description: Delegate local Codex tasks to DeepSeek Harness through a self-describing MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate local work to DeepSeek Harness.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex App and Codex CLI to a three-process pool of local DeepSeek Harness sessions. A concise session hint routes independent parallel work across self-describing MCP servers with named long-lived sessions, continuation, inspection, and archival.
defaultPrompt: Ask DSH to inspect this workspace with the default settings.
Delegate this task to DSH in read-only mode.
Run three independent DSH tasks in parallel.
Create a named DSH session and continue it later.
